summary: When Nora speaks up on her own, for a reminder, a gathering or a proactive message, she can now say where a member is in rooms where location sharing is turned on, just as she does when someone tags her.
details: Before, those turns treated every room as if location sharing were off, so in a room holding anyone she could not match to the location-sharing circle she refused to say where anyone was.
limitations: She still only looks when the message calls for it; nothing yet wakes her when someone arrives or leaves.
